# REVV- Web

> REVV- Web is the official web portal and technical motorcycle hub for REVV – Riding Companion, hosted at https://revv.asteralabs.digital.

## Overview
REVV is designed for two-wheel riders and neighborhood motorcycle crews. It combines turn-by-turn navigation tailored for motorcycles, live squad telemetry, helmet intercom integration, digital garage maintenance logs, community feeds, and motorcycle journalism.

## Key Features
- **Riding Companion**: Coordinate pack rides, assign Lead and Sweep roles, view live rider locations, and resume multi-stage road trips without fragmenting route telemetry.
- **Turn-by-Turn Navigation HUD**: High-contrast, motorcycle-optimized routing designed for daylight and night cockpit displays.
- **Digital Garage**: Log vehicle specs, maintenance intervals, brake pad depth, tire pressures, and part wear schedules for your motorcycles.
- **Motorcycle News (Garage Desk)**: Dispatches on pre-touring checklists, wet-weather riding craft, pack intercom etiquette, and mechanical diagnostics.
- **Communities & Events**: Join verified clubs, participate in route discussions, and coordinate weekend runs.
- **Rider Identity & Feed**: Share post-ride telemetry stories, route polylines, and bike photos stamped with telemetry marks.

## Authentication Policy
- **Sign-In Only**: REVV- Web supports passwordless OTP login for existing riders via email, username, or phone number.
- **Mobile Registration**: Rider registration is exclusively performed via the REVV mobile app (iOS & Android). Account creation is disabled on the web portal.
